thread:
alex: FYI canary for fenris-v2q on int8 is showing a ~1.9% rise in funcall parse failures vs raven-v1 baseline. Sample rate small but consistent across two days. anyone digging?
jin: saw the alert this morning. quick glance at logs shows a lot of truncated JSON suffixes `}...` and some broken escapes.
maria: Ugh. repro prompt?
alex: small repro in canary harness attached below. failing output looks like:```
{"action":"search","args":{"query":"open source inference"}
...
```
alex: note the missing closing newline + sometimes we get a trailing `,` before the final brace.
eva: important: this only shows up when kv-cache reuse + streaming is enabled (our default for canary). disabling streaming in the mirror cut failure rate in half.
jin: that points at tokenizer/kernel boundary. int8 path might be truncating chunk boundaries in streaming kernel. canary-bot can we run a small bisect across runtime flags? @canary-bot run-bisect --target fenris-v2q --flags "streaming=true,kv_reuse=true" --variants "int8,int4,float32" --sample 500
canary-bot: queued bisect job 3521, will run sequentially across variants, expect ~45m. will post results here when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria: while that's running, can we capture raw token boundaries and last N tokens produced for failing traces? add a tiny probe to log last 32 tokens hex. minimal perf hit.
alex: good call. i'll push a dev mirror with probe. also let's run canary harness eval for structured-output compliance (schemaset: toolcall-v2) across variants and keep per-prompt diffs.
jin: checklist for bisect/analysis: 1) compare tokenizer offsets 2) check trailing-comma/whitespace heuristics 3) inspect KV cache size/flush timing 4) compare streaming chunk sizes 5) run non-streamed baseline to isolate streaming-only regressions
eva: quick mitigation: add lightweight postprocess that attempts to close dangling JSON (heuristic) and retry parse once before returning toolcall failure. not ideal but buys time for rollout.
maria: agreed. add to canary route only and enable as opt-in. we should gate by metric: parse_fail_rate drop > 60% and no quality regressions.
jin: if bisect shows int8 specific, we'll try microquant retrain or adjust chunking. also need to check compiled kernel selection — kernel A vs B had different streaming assembly.
alex: ok patch with probe and postprocess going to mirror now, i'll ping when the bisect job posts. thanks all. :thumbsup:
